participants.note: reviewed commit structure on MAX_BIP125_RBF_SEQUENCE deprecation comment
Concept ACK; raised multiple review comments regarding missing test coverage for replaceable=False, commit atomicity, and release note categorization
pointed out deprecated arguments must throw when supplied without -deprecatedrpc=bip125, opposed unnecessary test rename

claims.harm: deprecated options would be silently ignored when flag is not set instead of alerting user
claims.quote: If a user does add a replaceable argument but does not enable the deprecated flag it will be ignored without the user noticing. I think all deprecated fields should throw if used when the deprecated flag is not set.

claims.harm: mass renaming rbf_node to node in test breaks git blame unnecessarily
claims.quote: seems entirely unnecessary. Mass renaming things in that file breaks git blame, and I don't really see the benefit for changing the name.

claims.harm: release notes entry used an invalid section header
claims.quote: This is not a valid section header for release notes. This could either be a standalone Notable Change, in which case this section header should be a title that describes what the change, or it should be one of the standard section headers

claims.harm: RPC help examples would fail on default nodes because they include the deprecated argument
claims.quote: On a node started without -deprecatedrpc=bip125 (the default), three sendtoaddress examples in this help block still supply the deprecated option.

claims.harm: FundTxDoc documents replaceable as deprecated across all spend RPCs before those RPCs actually implement the deprecation check
claims.quote: This docs replaceable as deprecated for all RPC calls using FundTxDoc, but in this commit only sendall has the flag check and the error throw. For the other calls send, fundrawtransaction, walletcreatefundedpsbt the doc is incorrect until a future commit.

claims.harm: tests do not check replaceable=False for send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall, reducing test coverage while deprecated
claims.quote: This is a bit a duplicated comment from others I left, but just to summarize, this is not covering the cases for Replaceable=False for send, sendtoaddress, sendmany and sendall

claims.harm: createpsbt and createrawtransaction are categorized under wallet RPCs in release notes when they are rawtransaction/node RPCs
claims.quote: If I am not wrong, createpsbt, and createrawtransaction are not Wallet rpc

support.reason: supports deprecating the replaceable RPC arguments
